UK Visas and Immigration guidance for staff on how to approach asylum claims made on the basis of transgender identity. It covers:

additional considerations to keep in mind when assessing claims for asylum

issues to consider when looking at the persecution experienced and whether there has been a failure of state protection

objectively considering future fear within the legal, political and social context of the country of origin

We are aware this publication may have accessibility issues. We are reviewing it so that we can fix these.
